note: Edit this file to change funded directions, quotas and intake limits. The page, the apply API and the AI reviewer all read it.

trial.zh: 试跑额度：够跑通你计划里最小的那个实验。
trial.en: Trial quota: enough to run the smallest experiment in your plan.

full.zh: 完整额度：按你申请的计划给。
full.en: Full quota: sized to the plan you proposed.

research.zh: 成果突出的，长期给卡，邀请加入研究组。
research.en: Standout results get long-term compute and an invitation to the research group.

zh.title: 评测与 benchmark
zh.desc: 怎么衡量 AI 做研究、改进自己的能力。
examples: 防刷分、防作弊的评测设计

en.title: Evaluation & benchmarks
en.desc: Measuring how well AI does research and improves itself.
examples: Eval sets built from research tasks

zh.title: Harness 自进化
zh.desc: 让 agent 外面那层框架，在真实任务上自己变强。
examples: 自动改提示词、工具和流程
改进能否跨模型、跨任务迁移

en.title: Self-evolving harnesses
en.desc: Agent scaffolds that get better on real tasks by themselves.
examples: Does the gain transfer across models and tasks

zh.title: 把能力训进模型
zh.desc: 把 harness 学到的东西，压进模型权重。
examples: 去掉 harness 后能力还剩多少

en.title: Training it into the weights
en.desc: Compressing what the harness learned into model weights.
examples: How much survives once the harness is removed

zh.title: AI 做科研
zh.desc: 让 AI 自己提出、执行、验证研究想法。
examples: 判断研究结论对不对的验证器

en.title: AI that does research
en.desc: AI that proposes, runs and verifies research ideas.

zh.title: 其他：让 AI 自己变强
zh.desc: 不在上面，但属于这个大方向的，也欢迎。

en.title: Other: making AI improve itself
en.desc: Not listed above but within this frame? Also welcome.
